thread_title: S. flava var. rugelii clone F
breadcrumb: S. flava var. rugelii clone F

posts.body_html:
I really like this particular clone because it has a very well defined red blotch that you can see even from a distance, and there's something about the shape of the pitchers that makes it attractive. It's a medium-fast grower, but doesn't often produce a ton of side shoots.
